connector.name: Concessio
connector.registryDescription: Search 22,000+ infrastructure concessions: expiries, ownership, clauses, tenders. API key required.
connector.summary: Hosted at app.concessio.io over server sent events. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 7 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.concessio, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your Concessio API key, format ck_live_...>
